What does wedding coverage include?

Ian’s wedding photography includes full-day coverage and edited photographs in color and black and white. Your collection is tailored to the needs of your celebration.

How far ahead should we inquire?

Ian’s current website notes that he usually books about a year in advance. Inquire directly to discuss your date; availability is confirmed personally.

What happens first?

Begin with a conversation about your wedding, your plans, and the photographs you care about. Ian can discuss a collection suited to your day.
